references.text: God speaks to Jacob in a night vision and gives him promises and guidance, just as the Lord spoke to Gideon at night
God comes to Balaam at night with instructions, a parallel to how the Lord communicates with Gideon at night
The Lord delivers the enemy into Israel's hand, the same promise given to Gideon regarding the Midianites
God promises to deliver Sisera into Barak's hand, corresponding to the promise of victory given to Gideon
Gideon hears a dream in the Midianite camp that confirms the Lord's promise of victory
The Lord promises to deliver Jericho into Joshua's hand, using the same wording as for Gideon's victory
The Lord delivers Ai into Joshua's hand, following the same pattern of divine promise of victory
The Lord promises to deliver the Philistines into David's hand, corresponding to the promise given to Gideon
Abishai says that God has delivered the enemy into David's hand, using the same language as in Gideon's promise
